description: Synthetic single-line paragraph carrying inline math: 'the energy <E=mc^2> is conserved'. The three runs sit on ONE horizontal band, left-to-right: TEXT 'the energy', INLINE_MATH 'E=mc^2', TEXT 'is conserved'. At the layout level the intra-block run order is left-to-right by x (design 6.4/6.5 two-level ordering); order() must yield text -> math -> text. Listed out of order on purpose. Page 1000x300 px.
